'''''Mattberry Plant''''' was an abstract [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was one of two paintings made by [[Vanvi Hotne]] that were put on display at the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]]. It depicted, as suggested, a [[mattberry plant]].
